description.content: Retrieves physical locations across ShipBob's fulfillment network. An active location (`is_active=true`) is operational for fulfillment processes, including receiving inventory and processing returns. Access to locations varies: some are available to all merchants by default, while others require special approval. Use the `access_granted` parameter to determine if a location is available to the authenticated user, and `receiving_enabled` to confirm if the location accepts inventory.

query.description: Whether the inactive locations should be included or not
Return all the receiving enabled locations
Return all the access granted locations

response.name: Success

header.description: (Required) Authentication using Personal Access Token (PAT) token or OAuth2
